Definition: from G4253 and G1679; to hope in advance of other confirmation:--first trust.
BiblicalUsage: Proelpizo means to hope in advance, to trust before others have. Paul uses it once: that we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that first trust is the church's calling, to hope in Christ before the world catches up.
